title: Room plan of a 3D building (K-R131, K-R132)
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §4.5. The file a 3D manifest names in `data.rooms` (eden: map/data/eden_estate_rooms.json, written by blender/estate2/floorplans.py). Each room is linked to the pack's node tree by `node` (the id of the room's node); the room card, the people chips and the room list match by node id and use the name only as a fallback. Several rooms of one kind of space may share one node. Unknown fields are kept.

z.description: Floor level in metres above the first floor (layout z).

floors.description: Bottom to top; the ids equal the floors[] of the 3D manifest.

node.description: Id of the room's node in the pack's tree.

kind.description: A room kind; colour and label come from the manifest's room_kinds (K-R131).

poly.description: The geometry: the room's outline in layout metres (x east, y north), at least three points.
